en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muawiya Bin Hukeym, from Muhammad Bin Aslam, from a man from Tabaristan called Muhammad, said, ‘Muawiya said, ‘And I met the Al Tabary, Muhammad, after that, so he informed me saying, ‘I heard Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Musa<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘

The debtor, when he lends a loan’, or ‘borrows regarding a right’ - the uncertainty O Muawiya (the narrator), he will be given one year’s time to pay. If he still cannot pay the Imam<sup>asws</sup> would fulfil it on his behalf from the Public Treasury’.
